description: Update a quiz. `updates` accepts any subset of quiz settings (title, description, format, template, timing, music, TTS, publish status, etc.).

quizId.description: Quiz ID in YouTube-style 11-character base64url format.

updates.description: Partial quiz settings object; only included fields are updated.

answerFontSize.description: Answer text size. 96 is the template default. Text never clips, so it stops growing once it fills its space. Applies to built-in and custom templates.

backgroundMusicId.description: Background music track id from /api/v1/music. Omit to use the default YouTube-safe shared track; set null for silent.

countdownSeconds.description: Seconds of countdown shown before each question (3–15).

enableTTS.description: Whether to read questions and answers aloud via text-to-speech.

format.description: Output aspect ratio: "tiktok" (9:16 vertical) or "youtube" (16:9 horizontal).

isPublished.description: Whether the quiz is publicly listed on quiz.video. Setting this also ends "anyone with the link" access; use quiz_video_share_quiz to choose between private, unlisted and public.

musicVolume.description: Background music volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full). Default 0.15.

paceMultiplier.description: Global timing multiplier applied to durations and animations.

questionFontSize.description: Question text size. 120 is the template default: 180 asks for 150%. Text never clips, so it stops growing once it fills its space. Applies to built-in and custom templates.

quizType.description: Quiz mechanic: multiple_choice, reveal_answer, or picture_guess.

revealStyle.description: Animation style used when revealing the correct answer.

showQuestionCount.description: Whether to show the "Question N of M" indicator.

template.description: Visual template id (e.g. "neon", "minimal"). See /api/v1 templates list.

themeCustomization.description: Explicit custom theme to save on the quiz. Use this when you already know the exact colors/font.

description.description: Optional natural-language source description for the custom theme.

fontFamilyOverride.description: Font for all video text. A font without letters for the quiz language falls back to that language's own font for those letters.

name.description: Optional saved theme label, e.g. "Golden Theme".

styleControls.description: Set automatically by the API when an override is sent. Makes overrides reach every scene and custom templates, not just preset question and answer slides.

textColorOverride.description: Hex color of question and on-screen text.

themeDescription.description: Natural-language custom visual theme prompt. Example: "golden luxury game show". The server saves the generated themeCustomization and applies it automatically.

ttsAnswerTemplate.description: Template string used to phrase the answer for TTS.

ttsQuestionTemplate.description: Template string used to phrase the question for TTS.

name: quiz_video_update_quiz
title: Update quiz settings
